FN-E1U892-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 165
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Economic Development
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/10/2023
Senate Bill 165 as introduced creates the Alabama Site Development Fund to be administered
by the Board of Directors of the State Industrial Development Authority (SIDA) to be funded
from legislative appropriations, revenue sources directed by the Legislature, gifts, grants, or
investment income. The bill provides for local economic development organizations to apply to
SIDA for site assessment and site development grants funded from this fund. The Governor's
Recommended Fiscal Year 2023 Education Trust Fund Supplemental Appropriation bill
includes a $10 million appropriation to the Department of Commerce for the creation and
funding of this new fund.
This bill would also provide further for the current annual appropriation of up to $2 million
from the Capital Improvement Trust Fund to the SIDA to allow use of these funds for site
assessment grants and site development grants.
